fileMetadata.description: A Drive file's metadata plaintext (kutup-crypto/src/file_metadata.rs, FileMetadata): canonical JSON, "v" first (docs/plans/format-evolution.md); the version is 2 (the block format): version 1, a whole-file blob, is refused. The content commitment is required and encoded right after size; originalRevisionId (the first upload's revision, never changed) and stateRevisionId (the latest saved Yjs state) are optional canonical lowercase UUIDs, encoded after content. Unknown fields are kept and written back sorted after the known ones; a minimum reader ("min", else "v") above 2 is newer than this reader (its error starts "newer format: "); out-of-range values are refused. sha256 is the canonical base64 SHA-256 of the content (32 bytes, no other spelling).

photosLibrary.description: The Photos library record (kutup-crypto/src/photos_library.rs): an account record under the master key, its object the record's random id (the photosLibrary scope of the account-records store); revisions are covered by the account head.

driveNames.description: Folder hash key, name and content hashes (kutup-crypto/src/drive_names.rs).

driveOwnerKeys.description: An owned folder's key and a link's owner copy under the Drive root; the revision slot is the root's generation (kutup-crypto/src/drive_envelope.rs).

safetyNumber.description: Safety numbers (kutup-crypto/src/safety_number.rs, V3): Signal's fingerprint v2 (5200 x SHA-512 per side, 2 x 30 digits, CombinedFingerprints QR) with the stable id AccountRef::id_bytes() (the 16-byte account id, never the server's name) and the identity key the raw 32-byte Ed25519 account authority (no type prefix). A rename, of the name or the server, keeps the number; a reset or another account id changes it.

accountRename.description: Account renames (kutup-crypto/src/account_rename.rs): statements signed by the account authority, binding the account id, chained 1, 2, …; a client accepts only chains that verify for the account id it looked up and extend what it saw.

nameFold.description: Folded names (kutup-crypto/src/names.rs): the local part lowercase (ASCII only) without '.', '_' and '-'; an address folds its local part and lowercases its domain, or is null with an empty side.

accountRef.description: A person across servers (kutup-crypto/src/account_ref.rs): { server, accountId } in JSON; the string form aci:<lowercase hyphenated uuid>@<canonical server>; idBytes = the id's 16 bytes, what every signed, sealed, hashed or derived statement binds (the server is routing, docs/plans/identity-rotation.md §6); routingBytes = u16 server length, server, the id's 16 bytes, only where a server names an account next to a payload. Anything else is refused, a username@server included.
